text.title: Go Error Handling (AppError + Centralised Mapper) Output Contract
text.summary: Pins the shape of a valid Go Error Handling (AppError + Centralised Mapper) output. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the actual answer / chosen option / value produced
at least 2 sentences; cites at least one input artefact by name
list of input names with source paths or URLs

forbidden.pattern: rationale that does not reference any input by name
inputs_used empty AND decision is not 'no-op'
duplicate artefact_id within the same store

allowed-transformations.transformation: Trim rationale to no more than 500 chars, preserving numeric claims and named tools.
Promote 'no decision yet' to status='pending' rather than fabricating a decision.
Group near-duplicate inputs, recording the group with member count.

section.title: Code-shape contract (what the artefact describes)
section.p: The artefact above records the DECISION. This section pins the apperror package shape, the middleware order and the lint config that decision must produce.

example.note: %w wrapping, errors.As with status preservation, repository-boundary mapping.
Five violations: mutable global, %v wrap, equality compare, driver leak, status demotion.

list.item: Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output
AppError has Code, Message, HTTPStatus, Err and implements Error() + Unwrap()
Every wrap uses %w; no %v or %s at any error-wrapping site
Driver-specific errors (pgx.*, sql.*, redis.Nil) appear only inside repository/
Handlers return error; exactly one ErrorMapper middleware translates
Middleware order is RequestID, Recovery, Logger, ErrorMapper, Auth
golangci-lint enables errorlint, wrapcheck, errcheck, nilnil
Constructors only — no exported mutable *AppError package vars
Wrap preserves the inner AppError's HTTPStatus and Code
